items.title: Skip
items.summary: Absolute pile of garbage. The game has the worst lag spikes I’ve ever seen. It’s all just boring, generic, ai slop writing and characters. Go play Chaos Zero Nightmare if you want an actually card gacha game. This one is hard to even call a game. Very few choices and an extremely limited run of characters. Also, every single character you can pull is SSR so what’s the point of rarity if they’re all the same? It literally seems like someone punched into ChatGPT “What’s the lowest effort garbage I can make to scam people?” And this was the answer. I’m just happy I didn’t spend a penny on this trash.
items.author: Hdjdbbdnd
